title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program — Patient Cost-Share Schedule by Tier
content:
The figures below set the patient's share of cost on each tier of the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program. Each tier carries six cost-share terms:

- **Coinsurance** — patient coinsurance as a percent of the payer-allowed amount on each claim line after any deductible; on the self-pay tier it is the share of the Larkfield cash price the customer pays. Stated as an integer percent.
- **Copay per 30-day supply** — the flat patient copay, in USD, that the plan applies per 30-day supply on a claim line. A figure of 0.00 means the plan applies no copay. The figure informs the expected patient responsibility; it is the payer remittance that confirms it.
- **Deductible applies** — whether the plan's annual deductible applies to this product line before coinsurance. The deductible amount itself belongs to the payer and arrives on the remittance.
- **Crossover to secondary** — whether the patient responsibility left by the primary payer is automatically crossed over to an in-effect secondary coverage before any patient statement.
- **Medicare monthly insulin cap** — the most, in USD, that a Medicare beneficiary pays for each month's supply of each covered insulin product (Part D and MA-PD), or for a month's pump insulin (Part B). A figure of 0.00 means there is no Medicare cap on the tier.
- **Non-preferred copay per 30 days** — the patient copay, in USD, per 30-day supply of a non-preferred insulin dispensed under an approved formulary exception. Medicare tiers remain subject to the monthly cap.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coinsurance | Copay per 30-day supply (USD) | Deductible applies | Crossover to secondary | Medicare monthly insulin cap (USD) | Non-preferred copay per 30 days (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | 100% | 0.00 | No | No | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | 0% | 40.00 | No | No | 0.00 | 80.00 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | 25% | 0.00 | Yes | No | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | 0% | 35.00 | No | No | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | 0% | 35.00 | No | No | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | 20% | 0.00 | No | Yes | 35.00 | 0.00 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | 0% | 3.00 | No | No | 0.00 | 8.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- A copay shown as 0.00 means the plan applies no copay on that tier; a monthly insulin cap shown as 0.00 means the tier has no Medicare cap.
- Only the Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program runs its coinsurance after the plan's annual deductible; on every other tier the deductible term is "No".
- Only the Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program crosses the primary payer's patient responsibility over to an in-effect secondary coverage automatically.
- The three Medicare tiers — Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug, Medicare Part D and Medicare Part B Pump Insulin — each carry a monthly insulin cap of 35.00; the self-pay, commercial and Medicaid tiers carry none.
- On the self-pay tier the coinsurance of 100% expresses that the customer pays the whole Larkfield cash price.
